query: Build the publishing kit for the DevFees webinar - I need a YouTube title, description with chapters, and the socials cutdown specs.
expected_behavior: Produces the full publishing kit: SEO title, description with timestamped chapters, tags, thumbnail brief, and end-screen/CTA
Gives the per-platform cutdown specs (aspect ratios plus length for YouTube/IG/FB/LI)
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice)

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target surface, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free: produces the metadata and specs, the upload happens in YouTube / the social tools
